<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

Added a full-stack task management application. The backend provides JWT authentication, role-based task APIs, SQL Server persistence, soft deletion, dashboard counts, and tests. The React frontend provides authentication, protected routing, task CRUD pages, dashboards, profiles, and styling.

### Changes

**Task Management Application**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Domain contracts and persistence** <br> `backend/TaskManagementTool.Domain/*`, `backend/TaskManagementTool.Application/*`, `backend/TaskManagementTool.Infrastructure/Data/*`, `backend/TaskManagementTool.Infrastructure/Migrations/*`, `README.md`|Added domain entities, DTOs, service contracts, EF Core configuration, migrations, project structure, and documentation.|
|**Backend authentication and runtime** <br> `backend/TaskManagementTool.API/*`, `backend/TaskManagementTool.Infrastructure/Services/AuthService.cs`, `backend/TaskManagementTool.Tests/AuthServiceTests.cs`|Added registration and login endpoints, JWT generation, Identity configuration, exception handling, rate limiting, CORS, logging, and authentication tests.|
|**Backend task workflows** <br> `backend/TaskManagementTool.API/Controller/TasksController.cs`, `backend/TaskManagementTool.API/Controller/UsersController.cs`, `backend/TaskManagementTool.Infrastructure/TaskService.cs`, `backend/TaskManagementTool.Tests/TaskServiceTests.cs`|Added authorized task CRUD, filtering, assignment rules, soft deletion, dashboard aggregation, user listing, and task service tests.|
|**Frontend application shell and authentication** <br> `frontend/src/App.jsx`, `frontend/src/context/*`, `frontend/src/components/*`, `frontend/src/pages/Login.jsx`, `frontend/src/pages/Register.jsx`, `frontend/src/pages/Profile.jsx`, `frontend/src/services/api.js`, `frontend/src/services/authService.js`, `frontend/package.json`, `frontend/vite.config.js`|Added React routing, persisted authentication state, protected routes, navigation, login and registration flows, profile display, API authorization, and frontend tooling.|
|**Frontend task and dashboard workflows** <br> `frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx`, `frontend/src/pages/TaskList.jsx`, `frontend/src/pages/TaskDetail.jsx`, `frontend/src/pages/NewTask.jsx`, `frontend/src/services/taskService.js`, `frontend/src/App.css`|Added dashboard counts, task filtering, task details, task creation and editing, deletion, loading and error states, API helpers, and task interface styling.|

**Estimated code review effort:** 5 (Critical) | ~120 minutes

### Sequence Diagram(s)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant User
  participant ReactApp
  participant API
  participant Database

  User->>ReactApp: Submit credentials or task action
  ReactApp->>API: Send HTTP request with optional JWT
  API->>Database: Validate identity or read/write task data
  Database-->>API: Return result
  API-->>ReactApp: Return DTO or error response
  ReactApp-->>User: Render authentication, dashboard, or task state
```

<summary>frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx-15-23 (1)</summary><blockquote>

`15-23`: _🎯 Functional Correctness_ | _🟡 Minor_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Render an API failure state instead of empty data.**

Both pages clear `loading` after a failed request but do not store an error. The dashboard then displays zero counts. The task list then displays “No tasks found.” These states are incorrect when the API request failed.

- `frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx#L15-L23`: store the request error and render an error state instead of zero task counts.
- `frontend/src/pages/TaskList.jsx#L18-L27`: store the request error and render an error state instead of the empty-list message.

<details>
<summary>🤖 Prompt for AI Agents</summary>

```
Verify each finding against current code. Fix only still-valid issues, skip the
rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate.

In `@frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx` around lines 15 - 23, Update the request
flows in frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx (lines 15-23) and
frontend/src/pages/TaskList.jsx (lines 18-27) to store errors from
getDashboardCounts and the task-list request, respectively. Render an explicit
error state when a request fails, instead of showing zero dashboard counts or
the “No tasks found” empty-list message; preserve the existing successful and
loading states.
```

<summary>frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx-6-7 (1)</summary><blockquote>

`6-7`: _🩺 Stability & Availability_ | _🟡 Minor_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Recover from malformed persisted user data.**

`JSON.parse` throws if `localStorage.user` is malformed. The `AuthProvider` then fails to render. Parse in a `try` block and, on failure, clear `user` and `token` and start unauthenticated.

<details>
<summary>🤖 Prompt for AI Agents</summary>

```
AuthProvider’s persisted-user initialization to parse localStorage.user inside a
try block; when parsing fails, remove both user and token from localStorage and
initialize state as unauthenticated with a null user.
```

```
Inline comments:
In `@backend/TaskManagementTool.API/appsettings.json`:
- Line 3: Update the DefaultConnection setting to remove
TrustServerCertificate=True, preserving local development connection options
while requiring SQL Server certificate validation for deployed databases.
- Line 12: Remove the hardcoded JWT signing value from the appsettings
configuration, including the "Key" entry, and load it through the existing
deployment secret/configuration mechanism instead. Rotate the exposed key before
release and ensure token signing still receives the injected secret at runtime.
- Around line 20-21: Update the IpRateLimiting configuration associated with
RealIpHeader so X-Real-IP is used only when requests come through explicitly
trusted proxies, adding the application’s forwarding/proxy trust controls as
needed. If trusted-proxy configuration is unavailable, remove or disable
RealIpHeader lookups so clients cannot bypass per-IP limits by supplying
arbitrary headers.

In `@backend/TaskManagementTool.API/Controller/TasksController.cs`:
- Line 21: Update the CurrentUserId property in TasksController to validate that
ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier exists and is non-empty, returning an authentication
error before any task service operation when it is missing. Remove reliance on
the null-forgiving operator and preserve the existing authenticated-user flow
when the claim is present.

In `@backend/TaskManagementTool.API/Program.cs`:
- Around line 41-58: Validate Jwt:Key, Jwt:Issuer, and Jwt:Audience immediately
before configuring AddJwtBearer, rejecting null, empty, or whitespace values
with clear startup errors. Store the validated values and use them for
SymmetricSecurityKey, ValidIssuer, and ValidAudience instead of directly
dereferencing configuration entries.
- Around line 26-27: Update the DbContext registration around
AddDbContext<AppDbContext> to capture the DefaultConnection value before calling
UseSqlServer. Validate that it is present and non-empty, throw a clear
configuration error when missing, and pass the validated value to UseSqlServer.
- Around line 30-35: Strengthen the Identity password policy configured in
AddIdentity<ApplicationUser, IdentityRole> and align AuthController.Register’s
registration validation DTO with it: require a longer minimum password and
enforce character complexity instead of disabling uppercase and non-alphanumeric
requirements. Add breached-password screening or an equivalent registration
control, ensuring all public registration paths apply the same policy.

In `@backend/TaskManagementTool.Application/DTOs/Tasks/TaskCreateUpdateDto.cs`:
- Around line 13-16: Update TaskCreateUpdateDto and the CreateTaskAsync/update
validation flow to accept only defined TaskPriority and JobStatus enum values,
rejecting empty, numeric, and unsupported strings with HTTP 400 instead of
falling back to defaults or persisting unchecked parse results. Ensure both
create and update paths validate Enum.IsDefined before assigning parsed values.

In `@backend/TaskManagementTool.Infrastructure/Data/AppDbContext.cs`:
- Line 27: Synchronize EF Core migration metadata with the HasQueryFilter
configured in AppDbContext for TaskItem.IsDeleted. If InitialCreate is already
deployed, add a follow-up migration; otherwise update or replace InitialCreate,
ensuring both InitialCreate.Designer and AppDbContextModelSnapshot record the
query filter.

In `@backend/TaskManagementTool.Infrastructure/Services/AuthService.cs`:
- Around line 63-65: Remove the user-count-based role selection in AuthService
and assign User to every public registration; bootstrap administrators only
through controlled setup. In AuthController, keep the registration endpoint
restricted to standard-user creation, or require authorization by an existing
administrator before allowing privileged account creation. Apply the changes at
backend/TaskManagementTool.Infrastructure/Services/AuthService.cs lines 63-65
and backend/TaskManagementTool.API/Controller/AuthController.cs lines 18-26.
- Line 39: Update AuthService.cs at lines 39-39, 77-77, and 84-84 to remove
request.Email from duplicate-registration, unknown-user login, and
invalid-password logs, recording only the event type and a non-sensitive
correlation identifier. At line 91-91, replace user.Email with the established
non-sensitive audit identifier; preserve the existing authentication behavior
and log events.
- Line 63: Update the user-count operation in RegisterAsync to use the
asynchronous CountAsync() API and await its result, replacing the synchronous
_userManager.Users.Count() call while preserving the existing totalUsers
behavior.
- Around line 58-65: Update RegisterAsync to capture the IdentityResult returned
by AddToRoleAsync and stop registration when role assignment fails; only build
and return the JWT after the role has been persisted successfully, using the
existing roleToAssign value.

In `@backend/TaskManagementTool.Infrastructure/TaskService.cs`:
- Around line 105-113: After SaveChangesAsync in the task update flow, reload
the task together with its AssignedUser navigation before calling
MapToDto(task). Ensure the response reflects the new assignee’s matching
AssignedUserId and AssignedUserName when an administrator changes
dto.AssignedUserId.

In `@backend/TaskManagementTool.Tests/TaskManagementTool.Tests.csproj`:
- Line 12: Update TaskManagementTool.Tests so TaskServiceTests no longer rely on
EF Core’s non-relational InMemory provider: replace the package reference with a
relational SQLite in-memory provider and update GetDbContext() to configure and
keep the SQLite connection open for each test. Add SQL Server integration
coverage for provider-specific query and transaction behavior, while moving pure
unit tests away from EF persistence where appropriate.

In `@frontend/src/App.css`:
- Around line 312-420: Add a narrow-screen media query targeting .sidebar and
.main-content: reflow or overlay the fixed 220px sidebar so it no longer
consumes the full mobile width, and reduce .main-content padding for small
viewports. Ensure task content remains usable without horizontal overflow while
preserving the existing desktop layout.

In `@frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx`:
- Around line 9-25: Update login in AuthContext to stop persisting the bearer
token and profile PII in localStorage; move authentication to HttpOnly, Secure,
SameSite cookies with CSRF protection, and remove the localStorage token
retrieval from the api service. Keep setUser limited to the in-memory
authenticated profile state.

In `@frontend/src/pages/Login.jsx`:
- Around line 39-53: Associate every authentication form label with its
```
